div.div: 3 ظَلَّ يُصَائِكُنِى مُنْذُ اليَوْمِ He has continued vying with me, or contending with me for superiority, or striving to surpass me, in strength, or power, or force, (يُشَادُّنِى,) all this day. (O, K, * TA.) [And so يُصَايِكُنِى, mentioned in the TA in art. صوك; but app. belonging to art. صيك.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
